slides.title: About This Presentation
slides.content: This presentation is built using the IFD (Iterative Feature Development) methodology with native Web Components. No frameworks, no dependencies - just clean, maintainable code.

slides.title: IFD Principles
content: Real Data from Day One: No mocks, real backend from v0.1.0. Surgical overrides for incremental changes. Self-contained major versions.
Web Components: Native browser APIs, event-driven architecture. Co-located tests, zero external dependencies.
